recognize_zh: 高倍下見多形性浸潤：小淋巴球、胞質淡染或透明的中型細胞、帶泡狀核與核仁的大型免疫母細胞，加上散在的嗜酸性球與漿細胞；上方中央有管壁粉紅玻璃樣化的分支小血管（HEV），這種「多種細胞混雜加上血管增生」是 AITL 的特徵。
features: Polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes, medium-sized atypical cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, and scattered large immunoblasts
Large cells with vesicular chromatin, irregular nuclear contours and visible nucleoli
Branching vessel with plump endothelial cells and eosinophilic hyalinized wall (high endothelial venule) at upper center
Scattered eosinophils and plasma cells in the background
Pale eosinophilic intercellular material between the cells
describe_en: High-power section shows a polymorphous infiltrate composed of small lymphocytes, medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells with pale to clear cytoplasm, and scattered large immunoblasts with vesicular chromatin and nucleoli. Eosinophils and plasma cells are admixed, and a branching high endothelial venule with plump endothelium and a hyalinized eosinophilic wall is present. Pale intercellular eosinophilic material is noted. Findings are consistent with angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma; confirmation with TFH markers, CD21 for expanded FDC meshworks, and T-cell receptor gene rearrangement studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: cHL contains diagnostic CD30/CD15-positive Reed-Sternberg cells, whereas the large cells in AITL are a mix of EBV-positive B immunoblasts and TFH-phenotype T cells.
PTCL-NOS lacks the TFH immunophenotype (PD-1, CXCL13, ICOS) and the expanded perivascular FDC meshworks characteristic of AITL.
Reactive paracortical expansions preserve architecture and lack clear-cell TFH clusters and clonal TCR rearrangement.
